source_row.stem: A nurse recommends a community exercise program for an older adult client at risk for falls. Evidence-based fall-prevention exercise programs typically focus on:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Flexibility exercises alone, without any dedicated balance, strength, or gait-training component","B":"Cardiovascular endurance training alone, without any dedicated balance-focused component","C":"Balance, strength, and gait training, shown to reduce fall risk in older adults","D":"Complete avoidance of physical activity altogether, rather than a structured, supervised exercise approach"}}
source_row.rationale: Evidence-based fall-prevention exercise programs for older adults focus on balance, strength, and gait training, shown in research to significantly reduce fall risk in this population.
source_row.source_name: CDC STEADI Initiative — Fall Prevention Exercise Recommendations
source_row.source_detail: Components of Effective Fall Prevention Exercise
